key_insight: The paper investigates joint formation and failure loads in friction stir welding of 2024-T4 aluminum alloy to SGF-PEEK polymer using a four-stepped outward-tapered tool.
engineering_relevance: This dissimilar-material joining approach is relevant to lightweight metal–polymer structures where joint integrity and load capacity are critical.
method: Join 2024-T4 aluminum alloy and SGF-PEEK by friction stir welding.
Use a four-stepped outward-tapered welding tool.
Investigate joint formation and failure loads.
evidence_signal: The supplied abstract contains only indexing information, so no measured failure loads, process parameters, or comparative results are available.
watch_item: Tool benefits and joint performance cannot be established without the full experimental results and welding conditions.
paper_title: Formations and failure loads of dissimilar 2024-T4 aluminum alloy and SGF-PEEK polymer friction stir welding joints with the four-stepped outward-tapered tool
